# Images are generated by image-capable agents and stored in the Wiki

Any image Prep needs (battle maps, portraits, handout art) that doesn't already exist in the Wiki is generated by dispatching a subagent with native image generation, such as Codex, Grok or omp, and saved into the Wiki as an ordinary Obsidian attachment before Push. We chose generation over web-sourced or DM-supplied images so Prep never stalls waiting on an asset, and storing the result in the Wiki keeps it canonical like everything else.
